entries.text: the Little Dart Mk 11 is 50% done!

Worked on the Little Dart Mk 11 (version 9, 50% built): soldering a dedicated power switch for the reaction wheel assembly with extra heat-shrink tubing and gus to hold the line steady (used Captain, a perfectly good bolt)
soldering a heavy duty power switch onto the Little Dart chassis
entries.why: My joints are oiled up and the Little Dart needs its new power switch.

entries.text: Sand got into his left elbow joint. Again.
rolling over to the fuel depot for a warm cup of oil
entries.why: my dry joints are grinding like sand in a gear train.

entries.text: Woke up with the first sun, fully charged.
Put Captain (a perfectly good bolt) on his shelf.
plugged into the charging dock to sleep
